scientific_question: Does preserving exact identities of the frozen alternative geographic/environmental connectivity worlds predict held-out catalogued natural vascular-plant island incidence beyond strong compressed summaries of the same worlds?

frozen_world_universe.reconstruction: regenerate deterministically from validation/azores_confirmation/azores_climate.csv and benchmarks/freeze_azores_world_universe.py, then require the frozen fingerprint before parsing response rows

node_universe.locality_mapping: normalize distribution locality and each frozen node match_label/geonames_name/geonames_asciiname by Unicode NFKD -> ASCII -> casefold -> replace non-alphanumeric runs with one space -> strip; require exact equality to one node alias; unmatched localities are out of scope and are never reassigned

taxon_scope.canonical_identity: follow acceptedNameUsageID when non-empty and different from taxonID until an accepted core row is reached; blank/self acceptedNameUsageID denotes the canonical row; unresolved references or cycles are excluded and counted
taxon_scope.vascular_rule: canonical core row phylum normalizes to Tracheophyta OR higherClassification contains a normalized Tracheophyta token

response.name: catalogued_natural_vascular_plant_island_incidence
response.positive_pair: at least one mapped present distribution row with natural establishment and no mapped present non-natural/ambiguous establishment row for the canonical taxon-island pair
response.catalogue_nonrecord_pair: no mapped distribution row for the canonical taxon-island pair
response.excluded_pair: any explicit mapped distribution record that is not an unconflicted natural present record, including explicit absent, present non-natural, present blank/ambiguous establishment, or natural/non-natural conflict
response.zero_interpretation: catalogue non-record under the frozen mapping/status rule; never biological absence

outer_validation.training_row_reference: for training target island t, reference nodes exclude both the outer held-out island and t
outer_validation.non_estimable_rule: if fewer than 7 outer islands satisfy all frozen eligibility/model requirements, report independent confirmation non-estimable and do not retune

features.world_reachability_bit: 1 iff target node shares a connected component in that frozen world with at least one positive occurrence anchor in the row reference set
features.world_order: exact order produced by the frozen Gate 4 world universe

models.scaling: within each outer fold, standardize all R0/R1/R2 scalar columns using pooled training-row mean and population SD (ddof=0); zero-SD scalar columns become zero; in C_identity standardize the first ten R2 scalar columns identically and leave the 20 binary identity bits as 0/1

primary_metric.name: island_macro_binary_log_loss
primary_metric.per_island: mean binary log loss across all evaluable held-out taxon pairs on that island
primary_metric.macro_summary: unweighted mean across evaluable outer islands

identity_nonredundancy_check: among generated response-independent feature rows, group by the five R2 family support counts plus total world support; require at least one group containing multiple distinct ordered 20-bit world vectors; this condition does not use response labels
no_added_value_rule: If the run is estimable but every favourable condition is not satisfied, report no_confirmed_added_value for explicit world identity. Do not retune nodes, taxon scope, response mapping, worlds, climate variables/products, thresholds, R2, model hyperparameters, metric, or dataset choice.
claim_if_favourable: Only that, in this independently frozen nine-island Azores vascular-plant checklist system and declared finite 20-world universe, exact analyst-choice world identity retains held-out catalogue-incidence information beyond the frozen strong compressed world summaries. It does not establish true dispersal routes, biological absence, historical colonisation, universal robustness, generic algorithmic novelty, or superiority for other taxa/regions.
certificate: Exact only over the enumerated frozen 20-world finite universe; no continuous or universal ecological coverage claim.
